citations.quote_or_claim: In a lot of people's minds 1991 was the last great year of the Grateful Dead. It was for me, the last year of touring. This show really holds a dear place in…

citations.quote_or_claim: If you are wondering which one of these versions to 'listen to', this would be the one kids. It sounds like butter. As for the boys playing; well let's just…

citations.quote_or_claim: Great show ! The post Brent era began with some great shows.It sounded like they were actually rehearsing some.Both of these shows were played almost perfect…

citations.quote_or_claim: I shirtless hippy in the upper deck yelled, "Jerry, play Dark Star" and they did. Acid was strong that night and the narcs were out in full force. It was an…

citations.author: Joshua_me
citations.quote_or_claim: Someone *finally* plugs Jerry in @ 5:20 in Jack Straw ! (Oh ! The licks lost to the ages ! ) Listen, this was one of the last *great* shows the boys played....…

citations.quote_or_claim: I was 16 and drove my parents beat up old suburban to the show packed full of friends. I was too young to get what a special show it was, but loved it, loved…
